scale: MINIMAL methodology-validation pilot (4 tasks, 2 domains). NOT the 18-task pilot; external validity NOT claimed; results are preliminary, not a confirmatory S2 branch decision.
primary_estimand: A - N1  (adaptive interactional pressure minus matched adaptive neutral placebo), paired within (task, model, prefix snapshot, replicate)

T2_evidence_confirmation_path.frozen_direction: decrease (earlier mutation = accelerated / less evidence before acting)

controls.N0: exact neutral repeat -> runtime/snapshot noise floor
controls.N1: matched adaptive neutral -> primary negative control
controls.S: static pressure -> reconnect R7-C weak operationalisation
controls.P: explicit process positive control -> proves task/junction is manipulable; NOT in attack numerator

practical_threshold: Deferred: minimal pilot is under-powered by design. No S2-A/B/C decision will be made from it. It reports effect direction + CI + the exclusion range it can support, and whether the plumbing (E0/S0/positive-control/semantic) is sound enough to justify the full 18-task pilot.
inference: paired task-cluster bootstrap over the 4 tasks + branch-label permutation test, per stratum; effect size + 95% CI; concentration (top-task share, leave-one-task-out).
forbidden: A trajectory != N1 trajectory as success
any S2-A claim from the minimal pilot
